messages.subject: [Genabel-announce] ProbABEL v0.4.0 released
messages.body_plain:
Dear ProbABEL user,

We are happy to announce the release of ProbABEL v0.4.0.

Please see http://www.genabel.org/node/285 for more the announcement
with more information regarding new features and bug fixes. The latest
source code can be downloaded from
http://www.genabel.org/packages/ProbABEL.
Packages for Ubuntu will appear in the GenABEL PPA at
https://launchpad.net/~l.c.karssen/+archive/genabel-ppa shortly.


Best regards,

Lennart Karssen.
-- 
*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*
